identity.name: Setuid Privilege Escalation via chmod u+s on Shell Binary
identity.summary: An attacker modifies a shell binary in a writable path with the setuid bit to gain elevated privileges. Cortex should detect the manipulation of setuid/setgid file bits on executables.
identity.description: An attacker modifies a shell binary in a writable path with the setuid bit to gain elevated privileges. Cortex should detect the manipulation of setuid/setgid file bits on executables.

biocs.name: Setuid Bit Manipulation
biocs.description: Detection of chmod command setting setuid bit on executable files
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'chmod' and action_file_path contains 'shell' and action_command_line contains 'u+s'

abiocs.name: Setuid and Setgid file bit manipulation
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation detected when setuid/setgid bits are manipulated on files in writable paths
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type = ENUM.FILE_MODIFY
| filter action_file_path contains '/tmp/scratch/shell' and action_command_line contains 'u+s'

xql_queries.name: Setuid File Bit Manipulation Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type = ENUM.FILE_MODIFY
| filter action_command_line contains 'u+s' and action_file_path contains '/tmp/scratch/'
